"Since the University of Twente’s founding in 1961, we have been deeply connected with the rich industrial heritage of our region and the well- being of its population. We proudly carry that forward, both at home and internationally. Today we are a catalyst to many high tech communities and sectors with strong partnerships in a wide range of industries and societal domains. We participate in ground-breaking, globe-spanning networks and programmes. We maintain lifelong connections with more than 50,000 alumni worldwide."


Additional eligibility criteria

  • At least 50% (bachelor level courses) or >60% of the courses (master level) must be chosen from the Faculty of Science and Technology.
  • The exchange is only for one term (not possible to apply for the academic year)
  • Minimum 2 years of Bachelor's degree must be finished before applying.
Erasmus: Universiteit Twente - ENG (Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Water and Environmental Engineering)

The University of Twente (UT), based in Enschede, the Netherlands, is a well-regarded technical university specialising in engineering, social sciences, and entrepreneurship. Established in 1961, it is one of the country’s younger universities but consistently ranks among the global top 200. UT is particularly known for its hands-on, project-based learning, which encourages collaboration and practical problem-solving.

With more than 50 programmes taught in English, UT attracts a significant number of international exchange students. The academic environment is rigorous and can be challenging, but the university offers strong support, including mentoring and student services, to help students. The campus is modern and self-contained, while Enschede itself provides a more affordable living cost compared to larger Dutch university cities.

The University of Twente is a public technical university located in the town of Enschede, in east Netherlands close to German border. Its close links with global companies like Google, Philips, Boeing and Siemens help the students to find work experience and internship opportunities. It is one of Holland’s most entrepreneurial universities having a powerful start-up culture. Enschede is a medium sized city in the eastern province of Twente. In former times Enschede was a major centre of the textile industry, but now it is a university city that also has business, scientific and technology areas.

Twente is one of the co-location centres of the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), being Aalto’s partner in EIT Digital Master School (Information and Communication Technology).

It is possible to apply to U Twente only during January application period. It is not possible to apply to U Twente in Aalto's autumn application period.

Additional eligibility criteria

  • Bachelor students applying to U Twente are expected to have completed at least 90 ECTS by the time of exchange.
